raw_output_policy: raw TCP streams, full event logs, platform logs and generated replay output stay under ignored runtime/protocol-research paths

selection.selection_scope: first focused V2 safe-action proof input only; not accepted protocol mapping evidence

actions.status_reason: page switching changes only transient fixture UI state
actions.residual_risk: candidate only until recovery proof shows page A is restored

action.api_intent: set focus to existing edit field without changing value

actions.status_reason: focus change targets an existing fixture field and does not edit data
actions.residual_risk: candidate only until live focus proof confirms the same target identity

deferred_or_excluded_actions.reason: row selection is safe-cataloged but broader than the first page/focus proof

deferred_or_excluded_actions.reason: menu expansion is harder to distinguish from command invocation and is not needed for the first proof
deferred_or_excluded_actions.residual_risk: popup identity drift could accidentally approach command-like behavior
